metadata.description: Claude Code skills for everyday engineering work.

plugins.name: real-skills

plugins.name: task-checklist
plugins.description: Mod: a live Checklist pane for the task in progress. Mirrors the agent's task list, lets you check, uncheck and add items, and tells the agent what you changed.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Mod: a Plan pane for a master plan. Steps with collapsible tasks and their progress, overall progress, kept per project across sessions; the agent lays it out from your specs and plans and keeps it current.
